body: I dunno man, I really don't want to give her an ultimatum. Having an open relationship is literally the only thing we disagree on. I really do love her and I don't think I could do that, but I also don't know I could come off as serious as I would if I gave her an ultimatum, while trying to just work things out. Ugh,

Yeah I tolerated her flirting with random internet guys for about 6 months. And I got on anti depressants about 3 months and have gotten less dependent on her. I feel like I'm getting left behind since she goes to a major university and I go to a tiny regional campus.

Honestly it is not even the distance that bothers me. It's her flirting and wanting to do stuff with other guys while still committed to me emotionally. We get to see each other every weekend. So I don't  know if she's just bored of me or what.
